</title>

<traits>

<trait label="Monk" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=112" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Wake the Dead #2](/Sources.aspx?ID=207) pg. 28

**Prerequisites**

</column>

---

Everything is connnected—all is part of the whole, and the whole is distributed throughout the infinite parts. Find where to add your ki and you can break the whole. You gain the [_ki cutting sight_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1424) ki spell. Increase your number of Focus Points in your focus pool by 1.
name: Ki Cutting Sight
